name: ThreadBench
title: ThreadBench: Benchmarking Realism in Agentic Simulation of Real-world Discussions

source.note: Pass flags are transcribed from the published table formatting; p-values are rounded, so displayed .05 values must not be used to recompute pass decisions.
source.inventory_note: Paper Table 1 lists domain subdomain counts summing to 117 while the abstract and total report 116. Both are preserved pending author correction.

families.name: Uniformity
families.question: Do people bring different ideas?
families.description: Three complementary views of repetition, from shared phrases to shared meaning.
metrics: Pairwise 4-gram overlap between comments detects repeated wording.
Contextual similarity between comments detects paraphrases and similar expressions.
Mean cosine similarity with all-mpnet-base-v2 captures convergence in meaning.

families.name: Expression
families.question: Does the conversation feel personal?
families.description: Personal experience and emotional variation capture different parts of how people express themselves.
metrics: StorySeeker estimates the prevalence of personal stories and first-person experiences.
Entropy of GoEmotions labels measures emotional diversity across comments.

families.name: Tone
families.question: How do people address one another?
families.description: Interpersonal manner and disagreement are measured separately: people can disagree politely.
metrics: Fraction of comments classified as polite by Intel/polite-guard.
Fraction of comments classified as neutral by Intel/polite-guard.
Fraction of comments classified as impolite by Intel/polite-guard.

families.name: Interaction
families.question: How does a discussion grow?
families.description: Reply depth, branching and variation in contribution length describe the shape of a discussion.
metrics: Mean reply depth measures how far multi-step exchanges develop.
Mean shortest-path distance between comments captures the spread of interaction across the reply tree.
Coefficient of variation of comment lengths measures the mixture of short reactions and longer contributions.

human_evaluation.aggregation: Pair-level majority vote, ties excluded. Generated-thread selections and cannot-distinguish votes count together as not distinguished.
